The linters are unhappy with some of our TS declarations
act-verdict-parity asserts against source text, so it passes on a call whose result is discarded

Program Seed Data Creation
The version-skew remedy names a React package on Vue projects, and the daemon branch cannot converge when the daemon is newer
Project stack is still frequently unknown, which blocks every per-framework quality question
Decide: visual baselines and capability contracts have no adoption at all — delete them or invest in them
The no-session diagnosis computes a ranked reason and throws it away as prose, so the never-instrumented cohort has no cause
A truncated response body is graded as a hard failure instead of undecidable
Redaction rewrites the URL the grader matches against, so urlContains cannot match a public path
assert's timeout_ms is inert: the no-session error short-circuits before any waiting happens
The leaseExpired flag latches on a lifetime counter, so every closed human tab is blamed on an expired lease forever
Three install paths produce a page that can never authenticate, and none of them says so
No keep-alive agent on the MCP proxy's POST leg, so every tool call opens a fresh socket and ENOBUFS kills the call with no retry
Contradictions have no first-party/third-party axis, so an analytics beacon can overturn a verdict the caller proved

[agent] reticle_sessions does not say a dev server is already listening
[agent] recorded flows do not capture navigations, so a flow that backtracks cannot replay
[agent] flow replay cannot express a wait, and races a fill that triggers an async re-render
[agent] advertised timeout_ms exceeds what MCP clients will wait, with no bounded-wait alternative
[agent] a second reticle_lease acquire on the same origin poisons default session resolution
[agent] reticle_storage can read all three areas but cannot write one
[agent] an origin in RETICLE_ALLOWED_ORIGINS without a scheme is silently discarded
[agent] reticle verify tells you to pass sessionId, and has no such flag
